artifact.goal: Close out the required cases that only exist once the server, exporter, frontend and CLI are all real — non-mutation after serve and export, hostile-string rendering in Chromium, verification scope behaviour, the full file:// navigation circuit with zero HTTP requests, and the wheel-install checks with and without the review extra — and wire the section 10 acceptance gate, including the grep invariant encoded as a test.
artifact.title: End-to-end, browser, offline and packaging acceptance
artifact.next_action: Create tests/test_review_acceptance.py with the two cheapest cross-component gates first: required case 5 (serve and export against the fixture store and its bundle, then assert verify_bundle returns () and nothing was written inside objects/sha256/), and the section 10 grep test asserting execute_plan, compile_plan and persist_report appear nowhere under src/assay/review/ or web/.

decisions_made.decision: Required case 5 is asserted after actually serving and exporting against the fixture store and its bundle: verify_bundle on the exported bundle still returns no failures and nothing was written inside objects/sha256/.
decisions_made.rationale: The read-only property is only meaningful if it survives the full surface running against the store, not just a unit-level claim about each function.

decisions_made.decision: Required case 14 opens the export in Chromium with the shared hostile-string fixture values placed in source, paths, labels and diagnostics, and asserts no injected code runs and every decoded and displayed string is exactly as recorded.
decisions_made.rationale: Escaping correctness is a property of the rendered document, not of the escaper in isolation; the same constant set is used by the server, exporter and browser suites so no surface is tested against its own payloads.

decisions_made.decision: Required case 15 covers both verification scopes on a working store with multiple runs and an unrelated blob (root passes, exact-bundle reports extra objects), both scopes on the appropriate exact bundle, current-report verification explicitly including recomputation, stale-engine report verification returning partial with its closure checks named and never full success while corrupt bytes still return failed, and GET being unable to trigger either POST-only action.
decisions_made.rationale: The scope distinction is the whole point of offering two; an implementation that quietly treats them the same would pass any weaker test.

decisions_made.decision: Required case 21 opens the exported HTML via file:// and navigates the grid, cell detail, every arm pair, ambiguity links, traces, object downloads and report-linked runs, exercises fragment reload and back/forward, and asserts zero HTTP(S) requests by denying all requests at the browser level; verification, recompute and refresh stay disabled with reasons.
decisions_made.rationale: Denying at the browser level is what makes a fetch fallback fail the test rather than silently succeed against a reachable server.

decisions_made.decision: External-reference assertions inspect actual DOM attributes; object text that merely looks like a URL is treated as legitimate data.
decisions_made.rationale: Evidence routinely contains URL-shaped strings; flagging them would make the assertion fail on healthy fixtures and train people to loosen it.

decisions_made.decision: Required case 24 builds the wheel, installs it WITHOUT the review extra into a clean venv outside the source checkout and exercises discovery and static export there while `assay review serve` reports its missing dependency, then installs WITH the extra and serves the committed assets from outside the source checkout; browser tests confirm loading/empty/error states, keyboard access, action pending states, and separate labels for missing, negative and ambiguous data.
decisions_made.rationale: Running from outside the checkout is what stops an asset accidentally resolved from the working tree from passing the test.

decisions_made.decision: The section 10 grep invariant — execute_plan, compile_plan and persist_report appear nowhere under src/assay/review/ or web/ — is encoded as a test.
decisions_made.rationale: A one-time manual grep is true on the day it is run; a test keeps it true.

decisions_made.decision: Static-export browser tests deny all HTTP(S) requests; HTTP tests use the in-process ASGI client; no test makes a provider call or needs Docker or the network; toolchain and browser binaries are installed during CI setup, not as package runtime requirements.
decisions_made.rationale: Keeps the suite hermetic and keeps Playwright and Bun out of the shipped package's dependency surface.

decisions_made.decision: This work is its own cohort rather than folded into whichever earlier cohort finishes last.
decisions_made.rationale: Cross-component cases with no clear owner are the ones that get quietly dropped.

acceptance_criteria: All 24 required cases in spec section 9.1 have passing tests.
Opening the export in Chromium with the hostile-string fixture sets no injected global, executes no injected script, and displays every string exactly as recorded.

The file:// export completes a full navigation circuit (grid, cell detail, every arm pair, ambiguity links, traces, object downloads, report-linked runs, fragment reload, back/forward) with zero HTTP(S) requests observed.

Root verification passes on a working store with an unrelated blob while bundle verification reports extra objects; both pass on the exact bundle; stale-engine report verification returns partial and corrupt bytes return failed.

The wheel installed without the extra, outside the source checkout, runs discovery and static export, and `assay review serve` reports the missing extra; installed with the extra it serves the committed assets from outside the checkout.
No occurrence of execute_plan, compile_plan or persist_report exists under src/assay/review/ or web/, asserted by a test.
The full section 10 acceptance gate passes, including `uv build` with no Bun or Node on PATH.

approaches_rejected.reason: If a server happens to be reachable, a fetch fallback succeeds silently and the test passes; denying all requests at the browser level makes the fallback fail loudly.
approaches_rejected.approach: Allow HTTP(S) requests during the static-export browser tests and simply assert none were observed.

approaches_rejected.reason: A static asset resolved by accident from the working tree would pass, which is precisely the regression the check exists to catch.
approaches_rejected.approach: Run the wheel-install checks from inside the source checkout.

approaches_rejected.reason: It is only true on the day it is run; as a test it stays true.
approaches_rejected.approach: Leave the execute_plan / compile_plan / persist_report grep as a manual pre-merge check.

approaches_rejected.reason: Evidence legitimately contains URL-shaped text; the assertion inspects real DOM attributes instead.
approaches_rejected.approach: Flag any object-derived string containing a URL as an external reference.

approaches_rejected.reason: They only exist once all four components are real, and without an owner they get dropped.
approaches_rejected.approach: Fold the cross-component cases into the server, exporter or frontend cohort.

approaches_rejected.reason: They are CI setup concerns; adding them to the package would contradict the core-only installation requirement.
approaches_rejected.approach: Make Playwright or Bun a package runtime requirement so the browser tests can run anywhere.
